sentences.text: Christopher Alvin Stapleton -LRB- born April 15 , 1978 -RRB- is an American singer-songwriter and guitarist .

He is an established songwriter with six country number-one songs including the five-week number-one `` Never Wanted Nothing More '' recorded by Kenny Chesney , `` Love 's Gon na Make It Alright '' recorded by George Strait , and `` Come Back Song '' recorded by Darius Rucker .	Never Wanted Nothing More	Never Wanted Nothing More	Kenny Chesney	Kenny Chesney	George Strait	George Strait	Come Back Song	Come Back Song	Darius Rucker	Darius Rucker

Over 150 of Stapleton 's songs have appeared on albums by such artists as Adele , Luke Bryan , Tim McGraw , Brad Paisley and Dierks Bentley .	Adele	Adele	Luke Bryan	Luke Bryan	Tim McGraw	Tim McGraw	Brad Paisley	Brad Paisley	Dierks Bentley	Dierks Bentley
Among other artists , he has co-written with Vince Gill , Peter Frampton and Sheryl Crow .	Vince Gill	Vince Gill	Peter Frampton	Peter Frampton	Sheryl Crow	Sheryl Crow

After serving as the frontman of bluegrass group The SteelDrivers from 2008 to 2010 , Stapleton released his debut studio album Traveller in 2015 , which reached number one on the US Billboard 200 and was certified double platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America -LRB- RIAA -RRB- . Among several accolades , he won the Country Music Association Awards and the Academy of Country Music Awards for Album of the Year and Male Vocalist of the Year , and the Grammy Award for Best Country Album and Best Country Solo Performance at the 58th annual ceremony .
